displayName: Gcenx wine-devel 11.18 (vanilla upstream Wine; control engine)
notes: Control engine (plan §3 Phase 2 step 5): vanilla upstream Wine from Gcenx's macOS_Wine_builds. DXMT must FAIL on it (winemac.so exports no macdrv_functions) and msync is absent; it exists to prove the capability gates, not to run games.
TODO(REA): sha256 is TBD; EngineStore refuses to install an unpinned source. Pin it on first download (`shasum -a 256 wine-devel-11.18-osx64.tar.xz`) and confirm the layout with `tar tJf`.

TODO(REA): extract/paths assume the asset unpacks as `Wine Devel.app/Contents/{Info.plist,MacOS/,Resources/wine/{bin,lib,share}}` (Gcenx's usual packaging), so strip 2 into app/ yields app/Resources/wine/bin/wine. Fix the three paths if `tar tJf` says otherwise.

Capabilities are expectations (not yet probed): no WINEMSYNC, no WINEESYNC, no WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND, no CX_APPLEGPTK hook, no macdrv_functions export; WoW64 (i386-windows without i386-unix) as all Gcenx 10.x+ builds. EngineStore re-probes at install and records what the binaries say.
